बॉक्स ऑफिस पर रामायण का जलवा अभी भी बरकरार है! 🔥

फिल्म ने अपने पहले हफ्ते के बाद दूसरे वीकेंड में भी तगड़ी कमाई की तैयारी कर ली है।
दूसरे शुक्रवार यानी नौवें दिन के लिए फिल्म ने एडवांस बुकिंग में पांच लाख उनास्सी हजार टिकट बेच डाले हैं।
ग्रॉस कलेक्शन सत्रह करोड़ अठाानवे लाख रुपये रहा है और नेट कलेक्शन पंद्रह करोड़ चौबीस लाख रुपये है।
दूसरे गुरुवार को जहां पच्चीस हजार पैंसठ शोज थे, वहीं दूसरे शुक्रवार को शोज घटकर चौबीस हजार तिहत्तर रह गए हैं।
फिल्म का नेट कलेक्शन नौवें दिन चालीस से चौवालीस करोड़ रुपये तक रहने की उम्मीद जताई जा रही है।
इस शानदार आंकड़े के साथ फिल्म धुरंधर टू का सबसे बड़े दूसरे शुक्रवार का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ने की रेस में है।
क्या रामायण तोड़ पाएगी धुरंधर टू का रिकॉर्ड? 🍿

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 9 Advance Booking & Prediction: Grosses Almost 18 Crore, Threatens Dhurandhar 2’s Record For Biggest 2nd Friday Ever
ctx.summary:
Ramayana gears up to start its second week on a high note at the Indian box office, having sold 5.79 lakh tickets before the first show on day 9. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 9 Advance Booking & Prediction: Grosses Almost 18 Crore, Threatens Dhurandhar 2’s Record For Biggest 2nd Friday Ever  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana finished its first week on a strong note and is now looking forward to having a blast in the second weekend. Going by the advance booking numbers for the second Friday (day 9), the magnum opus will see some drop, but it won’t be worrying. In fact, the film has a chance to register the biggest second Friday at the Indian box office by overtaking Dhurandhar 2’s record collection. Keep reading for a detailed report!
Entering into the second week, the Bollywood magnum opus has lost some shows, but the number isn’t big. On the second Thursday, the film had 25,065; now, on the second Friday, the number stands at 24,073, a loss of only 992 shows. Such a number in the second week is historic. Besides, the average ticket price is still high, just like the opening week, giving a significant boost to collections.
As per the advance booking update of day 9, Ramayana sold 5.79 lakh tickets (excluding blocked seats) before the first show started. In terms of collections, the film grossed 17.98 crore at the Indian box office through second-Friday advances. In net collections, it equals 15.24 crore. With such bookings, the stage is set for another solid day.
Besides strong advance bookings, Ramayana is expected to see good walk-in audience turnout as well. This positions the film to score 40-44 crore net at the Indian box office on day 9. With this expected number, it has a chance of registering the biggest second Friday ever.
As of now, Dhurandhar 2 holds the record with 42 crore , so the battle to overtake it is expected to be very close. The Bollywood magnum opus definitely has a chance to add another feather to its cap.
